claim_1.claim: CyTOF analysis of peripheral immune cells from 64 COVID-19 patients and 12 healthy controls showed depletion of CD16 monocytes, dendritic cells, and NK cells, as well as increases in plasmablasts in patients with severe and fatal COVID-19.

sources.quote: We saw similar trends in immune cell composition between the three modalities, including depletion of CD16 monocytes, dendritic cells (DCs), and NK cells, as well as increases in plasmablasts (PBs) in patients with severe and fatal COVID-19.
